title: VUA BDL read query v0.6
description: Read-only catalog, warehouse, download and product-dependency queries served by AMF from the local BDL (docs/protocols/bdl-queries-v0.6). AMF decides what is served; the renderer never touches BDL. The transport envelope belongs to the application contract — this schema freezes the operation vocabulary, the query closed set and the params. v0.6 adds two operations, both additive over the frozen v0.4 six and both READ-ONLY (the confirmed_by_human flip is the production build slice's write face; this family carries no write words): dependencies.lookup — the dependency reverse lookup at the heart of the U18 supply chain, and dependencies.listByProduct — the unfiltered per-product observation face where unconfirmed clues stay visible. Word faces ride the FROZEN BDL v0.2 closed sets (schemas/bdl/v0.2, frozen 2026-09-22 wt-4 batch 166 — before this vocabulary, per the ordering dependency declared in collab/proposals/030): depKind mirrors dep_kind, and the matching rule is the versioned read-time rule table owned by the protocol, never a stored equivalence. Results never carry paths.

catalogListParams.description: The v0.2 query closed set. entityType / relationKind are deliberately absent — entity and relation storage belongs to BDL v2; their presence is a contract error, never a silently empty answer. Entries are ordered by productId ascending (identity-derived, deterministic pagination).

text.description: Case-insensitive substring over title and productId; null or omitted = no filtering.

availabilityStatus.description: Exact match against the derived stable enum (never the raw word); null or omitted = no filtering.

libraryType.description: BDL v0.3: exact match against the stored account-library column; null or omitted = no filtering (rows with a NULL library match only unfiltered queries).

limit.description: Page size for the card wall.

warehouseItemId.description: VUA-generated local identity, stable and never derived from display names.

dependenciesLookupParams.description: The v0.6 lookup closed set. Matching runs under the protocol's versioned matching rule table (v1 = case-insensitive EXACT over dep_name — ASCII case fold only; stored names stay verbatim; no substring, no fuzzy, no equivalence guessing). A package-form input that is not literally present as a dep_name returns an honest empty set — nominal-to-packageId identity is never guessed.

name.description: The dependency nominal to look up, as the caller holds it. Matched per the versioned rule table; the input is never normalized into storage.

depKind.description: Optional filter riding the FROZEN BDL v0.2 dep_kind four-value closed set; null or omitted = no filtering. No fifth member exists — engine/SDK pins are stored as 'other' with the pin in version_hint.

dependenciesListByProductParams.description: One product, all its dependency observations — the unfiltered clue face. No name/filter keys exist: client-supplied filters are contract errors, never silently empty answers. Unknown productId follows the catalog.detail absence semantics (the application-face not-found, never a fabricated empty answer).
